'''Biscotti''' is a male NPC found at the entrance of the Startorch Academy talking to a prep student, '''Xilan''', about [[Mortefi]] and [[Lucilla]].

==Location==

==Idle==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:;'''Biscotti''' Your reference letter is from... the New Federation...?
:;'''Biscotti''' ...Wait, no. It's from ''Professor Mortefi''... at Huaxu Academy?

==Dialogue==
;(First time interaction)
:'''Biscotti:''' Wait, your reference letter is from the New Federation...? Oh no, it's from Professor Mortefi of Huaxu Academy?
:'''Biscotti:''' That name brings back memories. If President Lucilla knows he's now in Jinhzou, it would definitely hit her right in the feels.
:'''Xilan:''' So Professor Mortefi is an old acquaintance of the President? 
:'''Biscotti:''' More precisely, they were colleagues who shared the same scientific ideals.
:'''Biscotti:''' Back when Professor Mortefi was studying in the New Federation, President Lucilla was the chief editor of its top academic journal.
:'''Xilan:''' Uh, right... so about my paperwork...
:'''Biscotti:''' He grew disillusioned with the corruption in the New Federation's research community and planned to leave, so President Lucilla wrote a letter urging him to stay...
:'''Biscotti:''' It's been so long since I last heard anything about him. Didn't expect to get news of him here...
:'''Xilan:''' R-right... excuse me, about my paperwork...

:'''Mortefi's Projection:''' Hey! How long do you plan on boring my student with those ancient histories?
:'''Mortefi's Projection:''' We're not even that close. I can't stand listening to you blabber any longer.
:'''Biscotti:''' M-Mr. Mortefi! My apologies! I'll take care of it right away!
{{Dialogue End}}
